newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai's foreign investment up for Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai's foreign investment up for Jan-Oct.

text.p: Shanghai attracted $9.08 billion in foreign investment in the first 10 months of this year, up seven percentage points on a year-on-year basis, the Xinhua news agency reported on Tuesday.
Shanghai approved a total of 1,814 foreign-funded projects in the 10-month period, the agency said, quoting the city's Foreign Trade Committee.
The average investment for each project was $5.0 million, compared with less than $3.5 million last year, with 41 percent of the money going into large industrial projects.
Hong Kong remained the largest investor and Japan was second. Japanese contracted investments in the period totalled $1.47 billion, up 30 percent from the same period last year, the agency said.
The city had a combined total of $43.34 billion in foreign investment by the end of last month, it added.
